findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client immediately upon creation before you are paid, which leaves you unprotected if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: Intellectual property rights in the Deliverables shall remain with the Contractor until the Contractor has received full payment of all amounts due under this Agreement, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a minor adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms transfer ownership of the work immediately upon creation before payment is made. I propose updating this so that intellectual property rights remain with the Contractor until full payment is received, at which point ownership transfers to the Client. Please let me know your thoughts on this modification. Best regards,
